name: PNE AL Quality Baseline
description: Preserves Microsoft analyzer defaults and promotes verified naming and declaration rules for immediate editor feedback.

rules.justification: Enforces deterministic variable declaration ordering by AL object type. This is type ordering, not alphabetical name ordering.
Enforces Microsoft's type or object-name suffix convention for variables and parameters.
Requires temporary variables to use the Microsoft Temp prefix convention.
Requires approved Microsoft suffixes for Label and TextConst variable names.
Enforces Microsoft's AL naming style, including object and source-file naming.
Requires every AL object to declare a namespace. The setup check separately verifies the approved app-specific namespace value.
